fn skipTrivia toks: (List tr/Token) -> (Pair (List tr/TreeElement) (List tr/Token))
  (skipTriviaLoop toks (list))

fn expectClose rem: (List tr/Token) kind: String endPos: Int64 -> (Pair tr/Token (List tr/Token))
  (mt (listHead rem)
    ((none) (pair (tr/makeToken "error" endPos endPos) rem))
    ((some hd)
     (if (= (tr/tokenKind hd) kind)
       (pair hd (optionOr (listTail rem) (list)))
       (pair (tr/makeToken "error" endPos endPos) rem))))

fn elemsHaveError elems: (List tr/TreeElement) -> Bool
  (if (listEmpty? elems)
    false
    (let [(hd (optionOr (listHead elems) (tr/elemToken (tr/makeToken "" 0 0))))
          (tl (optionOr (listTail elems) (list)))]
      (mt hd
        ((tr/elemNode n) (or (tr/isErrorNode n) (or (elemsHaveError (tr/nodeChildren n)) (elemsHaveError tl))))
        ((tr/elemToken tok) (if (or (tr/isErrorToken tok) (= (tr/tokenKind tok) "error")) true (elemsHaveError tl)))))))

fn isAssignTarget n: tr/Node -> Bool
  (let [(k (tr/nodeKind n))]
    (or (= k "ident")
    (or (= k "privateIdent")
    (or (= k "memberExpr")
    (or (= k "optionalChain")
    (or (= k "parenExpr")
    (or (= k "arrayLiteral")
        (= k "objectLiteral")))))))))
